goal: Curate actual card-state and transition evidence before calibrating a current-client recognizer.

existing_evidence.known_content: Instructions page 1; its decorative card strip is not a playable board.
existing_evidence.sufficiency: Insufficient for card-state calibration, transitions, input/outcome pairing or held-out evaluation.

episode_split.minimum_review_set: At least one calibration and one fresh held-out episode, with distinct source pixels for each required stage.
episode_split.forbidden: Splitting adjacent frames of the same playthrough or reusing one PNG in both calibration and held-out coverage.
episode_split.limitation: Byte hashes detect exact duplicates, not visually identical re-encodings or undocumented related captures. Human review must preserve true episode independence.

metadata_to_preserve: Original recording.json bytes and digest, episode ID, declared provenance, start date and completion state
Original PNG bytes and digest, original filename/index, exact dimensions, PNG alpha presence
Client versus outer-window surface, explicit client rectangle, actual UI scale and game resolution when known
Original TimeMs values and whether their origin is source capture, callback or unqualified
Supplied input receipts, uncertainty, original proposal IDs if any, and links to subsequent image observations
Manual labels versus recognizer candidates, whole-episode calibration/held-out assignment

steps.collect: Read every available instructions page and visible level/rules text before selecting a game.
steps.do_not_infer: Decorative sample cards are not board slots or face references.

steps.collect: The full actual exposed board, its boundary, all card centers and two temporally distinct stable frames.
steps.do_not_infer: A complete preview does not qualify later group sizes or shuffled layouts.

steps.collect: The same board after cards turn over, retaining the whole window and identical geometry.
steps.do_not_infer: Unknown pixels or missing cards never default to hidden.

steps.collect: Before input, the supplied click/key receipt, transition/animation, then the stable revealed identity.
steps.do_not_infer: A proposal or click receipt is not a successful reveal.

steps.collect: A visibly nonmatching selection and its observed return state, keeping input evidence and intervening uncertain frames.
steps.do_not_infer: Do not label an intermediate animation as a finished mismatch.

steps.collect: A visibly matching selection followed through its actual completed outcome.
steps.do_not_infer: Do not assume matching requires two cards on every board or that the cards disappear.

steps.collect: Only if current rules and observed outcomes establish an inactive/removed display: capture its positive visual marker.
steps.do_not_infer: Empty background is not proof of a matched or removed card. Record not_used only with reviewed rule evidence.

steps.collect: Actual result/timeout/reward text with any incomplete board state preserved.
steps.do_not_infer: A cleared board alone does not prove a game win or reward.

steps.collect: A fresh shuffle/level/board transition with a new local board ID, new geometry qualification and explicit group size.
steps.do_not_infer: Never carry card positions or identities blindly into another board.

unknown_rules: Current instructions beyond the saved page 1
Matching group size for each board/level
Preview duration, flip/resolve animation and timeout behavior
Current UI scale/layout invariants and source-capture clock alignment
promotion_gates: Prepare a new draft; inspect unique-source counts before any annotation.
Manually annotate current-client frames; do not count synthetic or recognizer labels as manual ground truth.
Keep a fresh episode held out from reference construction and threshold tuning.
Resolve geometry, alpha and timing qualifications; preserve original bytes when deriving normalized images.
Export reviewed Board/Card observations to the existing label replay; supply real receipts rather than inventing them.
Build reviewed references and use the existing saved-image recognizer/replay. Report unknowns and confusion by state/identity.
Live controls, recorder launch, game navigation and installation remain separate explicitly authorized tasks.
